maker-api.label: The maker's own API
maker-api.note: One route for every maker's own API (the build and models.json name it `maker-api`: names with route null, conversions, base prices); its defaults and conversions are the models.json ones. Folded at the merge of 23 Oct 2026 from the part's per-maker routes, kept here for the record: anthropic-api (Anthropic API, operator anthropic: spellings ['Anthropic', 'anthropic', 'Anthropic API', 'anthropic-api', 'anthropic-first-party', 'served-by:anthropic'], prefixes ['anthropic/']); openai-api (OpenAI API, operator openai: spellings ['OpenAI', 'openai', 'OpenAI API', 'OpenAI direct', 'openai-api', 'openai_responses', 'openai/flex', 'served-by:openai', 'served-by:OpenAI'], prefixes ['openai/']); google-ai (Google AI (Gemini API / AI Studio), operator google: spellings ['Google', 'google', 'google_genai', 'gemini', 'gemini-flex', 'Google AI Studio', 'google-ai-studio', 'google-ai-api-direct', 'served-by:google', 'served-by:Google'], prefixes ['google/', 'gemini/']); xai-api (xAI API, operator xai: spellings ['xAI', 'xai', 'grok', 'xai/zdr', 'xai-zdr', 'served-by:xai', 'served-by:xAI'], prefixes ['xai/']); deepseek-api (DeepSeek API, operator deepseek: spellings ['DeepSeek', 'deepseek', 'deepseek-api', 'DeepSeek-AI API', 'deepseek-official-api', 'served-by:deepseek'], prefixes ['deepseek/']); alibaba-api (Alibaba Cloud Model Studio (DashScope / Bailian), operator alibaba: spellings ['Alibaba', 'alibaba', 'alibaba-cloud(hosted)', 'Alibaba Cloud International', 'bailian', 'bailian-compatible', 'dashscope', 'served-by:Alibaba'], prefixes ['alibaba/', 'dashscope/', 'bailian/']); zai-api (Z.ai / Zhipu BigModel API, operator zhipu: spellings ['Z.AI', 'Z.ai', 'z.ai', 'zai', 'zhipu-bigmodel', 'glm', 'Z.ai direct API', 'served-by:zai', 'served-by:Z.AI'], prefixes ['z-ai/', 'zai/', 'zhipu/']); moonshot-api (Moonshot (Kimi) API, operator moonshot: spellings ['Moonshot', 'moonshot', 'Moonshot native API', 'moonshotai'], prefixes ['moonshot/', 'moonshotai/']); mistral-api (Mistral API, operator other: spellings ['Mistral', 'Mistral API', 'mistral api(as printed)', 'mistral'], prefixes ['mistral/']). Spellings added 26 Oct (gaps-configdates): anthropic-opus5 (obviousbench: upstream Anthropic transport), kimi (platform.kimi.ai, Moonshot), meta (Inspect meta provider: Meta Model API), perplexity (Inspect perplexity provider), longcat (api.longcat.chat, Meituan), celeris (inference.celeris.ai, celeris-1), aion (api.aionlabs.ai, AionLabs), tinker and tinker-native (Thinking Machines, upstream thinkingmachines). The spelling openai-api (already in the merged routes) is withdrawn 26 Oct: Inspect openai-api is a generic OpenAI-compatible provider (obviousbench serves xAI and LM Studio through it), not the maker API. Spellings SpaceXAI, Zhipu AI, Moonshot AI added 26 Oct: vals.ai boards' `provider` cell names the model's maker (grok/, zai/, kimi/ ids) (/work/.salvo14/mig/convert-vals.ai/report.md §11).

Thinking off with xhigh/max on Opus 5 is sent as high (changelog 2.1.251, 2026-08-28; not expressed). inspect-ai.note: Inspect AI maps a level per provider (registry fix, 26 Oct 2026, from gaps-harnesses): OpenRouter provider identity with max sent as xhigh (from 21 May 2026); OpenAI responses provider identity, max sent as xhigh to models before GPT-5.6 (from 9 Jul 2026); Anthropic provider: reasoning_effort to adaptive effort on the 4.6+ models (minimal → low; xhigh → high on 4.6), each model from the commit that classified it, and a token budget on the earlier models (budget-converted, from 21 May 2026). Records end at the clone's HEAD (22 Oct 2026). Not encoded: Inspect's separate `effort` setting (max → high unless frontier), the thinking-off clamp (27 Jul), the Gemini and LiteLLM-proxy bindings (1 Oct), other providers (not read). Doubt → out: a step that documents nothing stays not established. Added 27 Oct 2026 (gaps9-routes): OpenAI identity from the introduction of the Responses effort block (18 Apr 2025), `max` -> xhigh for every OpenAI model 21 May-5 Jun 2026; Gemini 3+ (google provider): low/high as themselves from 20 Nov 2025, medium from 21 May 2026, xhigh -> high from 6 Jan 2026, max -> high from 21 May 2026; xAI Grok 4.x: low/medium/high as themselves from 7 May 2026. Records end at the clones' HEAD (26 Oct 2026).

terminus-2.label: Terminus-2 (Harbor harness)
terminus-2.note: Harbor's Terminus 2 passes reasoning_effort unchanged into its LiteLLM call (lite_llm.py, 16 Nov 2025) and reasoning.effort on the responses path (5 Feb 2026); the provider mapping is LiteLLM's, not the harness's: levels not established per provider (LiteLLM is called with drop_params=True and gates reasoning_effort on model names and cost-map flags that differ by version; see the report). Default (26-27 Oct 2026, gaps9-routes): a call with no level sends none, so it gets the maker's documented default over [21 Jul 2025, 15 Nov 2025] (terminal-bench Terminus 2: no reasoning or thinking argument in any commit) and [18 Nov 2025, 23 Oct 2026] (Harbor: option default None); 16-17 Nov 2025 is excluded (Harbor commit 3960cf6c sent the literal 'default' to LiteLLM until 7548bdef). Records copy the maker's default of each model (toward the maker's API only: via maker-api). LiteLLM adds no effort of its own that was found: for Gemini 3 it follows the provider's default unless enable_gemini_default_thinking_level_low is set (litellm/llms/vertex_ai/gemini/vertex_and_google_ai_studio_gemini.py, HEAD 26 Oct 2026); the other providers' defaults inside LiteLLM were not read.

huggingface.label: Hugging Face Hub (repository ids of open weights)
huggingface.note: A namespace for the repository ids of open weights ('Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B'), matched case-insensitively (the Hub resolves repository ids without regard to case). As a route: weights loaded from the Hub and run by the evaluator (Inspect's hf/ provider): self-hosted, engine not stated. Hugging Face Inference Providers (a router) is not this route. Added at the merge of 23 Oct 2026.
